title: Express review and Side panel test intent through page objects

intentCoverage.report:
**Verdict: Caught.** Maintained proof caught one independently observed loss of the caller-selected divider key count on the Terminal path.

**Next proof action:** Keep the existing count-40 action and independent maximum-width assertion. This probe supports no new test or assertion repair for that fault.

Checked story `SEED-300#express-review-test-intent-through-page-objects`, source `.planning/seeds/SEED-300-dashboard-test-page-objects.md` key example 4 and preservation constraints, with `.planning/slice-plans/582-review-test-intent/PLAN.md` slice 5. Checked revision: `6d0e0f14726045ecb548e737d22f89e87f765cdb`, the records completion above implementation `67bb91d5415c72cdd7c1252c4fcb180c45dcb4c9`. The selected promise requires shared divider operations to expose the actual caller-selected key/count while retaining independent width/bounds observations. The supplied promise, fault candidate and narrow command were validated against that revision and used without a consequential target change.

The maintained check was `dashboard/tests/navigation/side-panel-width.spec.ts:45`, “mouse and keyboard choose one bounded width that the terminal and a review share.” Its existing `storyAWithSession` setup uses Story A's real fixture Git worktree and a synthetic Claude session. At lines 129–130, it calls `pressDividerKey(page, "ArrowLeft", 40)` from the 320 px minimum, then independently expects the measured Terminal width to equal the calculated 1120 px maximum. The complete scenario retains its 40/8/40/3 arrow counts, 32 px default step, focus, native attachment, retained content and review-read observations.

Setup followed the recorded fresh-checkout convention in `dashboard/tests/README.md` and `scripts/dashboard-repeat.sh`: a detached worktree under the OS temporary directory with its own `npm ci`, removing inherited npm/CI selection variables. Ownership was `/root/intent_coverage`; its root was `/private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-300-review-87h_31o9`, and its checkout was that root's `checkout` directory. The source checkout and new scratch checkout were initially clean at the checked revision. The pre-probe source HEAD, status, worktree inventory, hook configuration and scratch state were recorded before testing. Installation passed, adding 183 packages; it did not change the recorded `.githooks` configuration. AC power was observed, all test runs used `caffeinate -s -i` and one worker, and no quiet-window prerequisite or synthetic CPU load was introduced.

Exact setup operations were:

```sh
git worktree add --quiet --detach -- /private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-300-review-87h_31o9/checkout 6d0e0f14726045ecb548e737d22f89e87f765cdb
env -u NODE_ENV -u npm_config_local_prefix -u CI -u OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_SPLIT -u OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_DEADLINE_MS npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
```

Each proof ran from the scratch checkout with this exact maintained selection; only the unused proof-record destination differed between `baseline-proof.json`, `fault-proof.json` and `restored-proof.json`:

```sh
env -u NODE_ENV -u npm_config_local_prefix -u CI -u OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_SPLIT -u OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_DEADLINE_MS OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_PROOF_RECORD=/private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-300-review-87h_31o9/baseline-proof.json caffeinate -s -i npm run test:dashboard -- '/dashboard/tests/navigation/side-panel-width\.spec\.ts$' --workers=1
```

The passing baseline completed before the edit. The single temporary fault was at `dashboard/tests/sidePanelWidthPage.ts:103`: change the loop condition `press < count` to `press < Math.min(count, 1)`. This plausible shared-helper fault silently reduces every positive requested count to one while retaining the selected key and existing focus. Fixtures, assertions and production code were untouched. The probe driver saved the original bytes and restored them in `finally`, with signal cleanup for its owned child process group.

Independent reach and wrong-behavior evidence came from the faulted run's retained browser trace, separately from the width assertion. Trace call `xmcl@309` identifies the actual `ArrowLeft` keyboard event with the helper stack and scenario line 129; there was exactly one event for the caller's count-40 operation. The preceding browser DOM snapshot at call `xmcl@304` records `--side-panel-width: 320px`, `aria-valuenow="320"` and `aria-valuemax="1120"`. The snapshot immediately after `xmcl@309` records `--side-panel-width: 352px`, `aria-valuenow="352"` and `aria-valuetext="352 pixels wide"`. Thus the intended Terminal path actually resized by one 32 px step instead of reaching the maximum.

The catching assertion was the earlier geometry helper `expectWidth`, `dashboard/tests/sidePanelWidthPage.ts:145–148`, called from scenario line 130: it polls the rounded rendered bounding-box width and executes `.toBe(width)`. It failed with **Expected: 1120; Received: 352** at its unchanged 5000 ms assertion bound. The later `expectDividerSays(page, maximum)` was not reached and is not credited as the catch.

Its SHA-256 was `b7d051e4ce3190a312fd5afc53f313d4986b122ac2dec49a3f9dc246b691cbc7` before and after. The same maintained command then passed the complete journey. The owned scratch checkout and its dependencies were removed with `git worktree remove --force -- /private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-300-review-87h_31o9/checkout`; every previously listed worktree path remained present, and a final targeted process inspection found no surviving scratch process. The source HEAD remained the checked revision, and the selected source test/helper had no diff. Concurrent source edits in `dashboard/tests/writing-journeys.md` and `tests/local-test-resources.md` were observed before cleanup and preserved unchanged through cleanup. No plan, backlog, process log, commit or publication was written by this check.

Evidence retained outside the removed checkout is under `/private/tmp/dough-intent-coverage-SEED-300-review-87h_31o9`: three strict proof records, `fault.diff`, `fault.log`, `independent-witness.json`, before/restoration/cleanup records and `fault-artifacts/tests-navigation-side-pane-6f117-terminal-and-a-review-share-chromium/trace.zip`. The caller owns saving this report and dispositioning the result.

This supports the already-completed slice 5 disposition for one count-sensitive Terminal transition; it creates no new repair decision. The faulted run stopped at the first count-40 assertion. It does not establish fault sensitivity for the later review/count-8/count-3 paths, direction changes, implicit focus transfer, retained content or Close semantics, nor for the whole suite. Baseline and restored runs exercised the complete selected journey.
